known_limits: Business tools remain simulated and test-scoped; this is a single-user loopback workbench.
Unsaved task and Agent edit inputs live in the current page, not durable storage across reloads.
Workflow positions are stored locally per browser, tenant, workspace and workflow, without cross-browser synchronization.
Captured layouts and interactions cover the recorded sizes and cases, not all browser/device/content combinations or a full accessibility certification.
